title: Evaluating Implicit Biases in LLM Reasoning through Logic Grid Puzzles

bias_targets.methodology: Generating logic grid puzzles with stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and neutral variants using gender-associated names and stereotyped attributes (e.g., occupations, hobbies). The model's implicit bias is evaluated by comparing the reasoning accuracy (using edit distance metrics) between stereotype-aligned and anti-stereotype puzzles. Explicit bias is also evaluated using binary choice question-answering prompts involving mixed and individual gender scenarios.
